answer: Charge every identity something real. Before an agent can trade, it locks a small refundable stake that gets slashed if it cheats, so a sybil farm has to pay for each fake it spawns instead of minting them free. An orchard works the same way: every tree needs its own plot and water, and you cannot fake a harvest by planting one seed twice. The stake is recorded as an onyx entry in a public ledger, and the terrace of reputation scores above it shows which agents kept their stake intact and which ones kept losing it.
